question: How does the LSTM encoder-decoder scheme EncDec-AD detect anomalies in multi-sensor time series?

reponse_systeme: According to [4], the LSTM encoder-decoder scheme EncDec-AD detects anomalies in multi-sensor time series by using the reconstruction error at any future time instance to compute the likelihood of anomaly at that point.
